title: Russians seek answers over hundreds missing after Ukraine's 2024 incursion
english: Many Russian families are frustrated by the lack of government assistance in locating hundreds of people who went missing after the Ukrainian military entered the Kursk region in 2024. Despite state media assurances that the situation was under control, many civilians remained in the area and lost contact with their relatives during the fighting. Affected families are now forming groups to search for their loved ones and have appealed to international leaders for help in establishing humanitarian corridors.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 የዩክሬን ጦር ወደ ሩሲያ ኩርስክ ክልል ከገባ በኋላ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የት እንደደረሱ ባለማወቃቸው የሩሲያ ቤተሰቦች በባለስልጣናት ላይ ቅሬታቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን ሁኔታው ቁጥጥር ስር እንደሆነ ቢናገሩም፣ ብዙ ሲቪሎች አካባቢውን ለቀው ባለመውጣታቸው ግንኙነታቸው ተቋርጧል። ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ቤተሰቦች የጠፉ ዘመዶቻቸውን ለመፈለግ በመተባበር ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት ሰብአዊ ኮሪደር እንዲፈጥሩላቸው እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Yukreen bara 2024 gara naannoo Kuursk kan Raashiyaa seenuun walqabatee namootni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman bakka bu'aan dhabamanii jiru. Maatiin namoota kanaa mootummaan isaan gargaaruu dhiisuun isaatti gadoodaa jiru; miidiyaaleen mootummaa oduu sobaa dhiheessuun namootni baay'een akka naannicha hin gadi lhiisne taasiseera. Maatiin miidhaan irra ga'e kun walitti dhufuun firoota isaanii barbaaduu fi dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa akka karaa nagaa baniin isaan gargaaran gaafataa jiru.

title: Niger military government reshuffles army command weeks after deadly mutiny
english: Niger's military leadership has announced a major reshuffle of its high command following a recent failed mutiny that threatened the current government. General Mamane Sani Kiaou has been appointed as the new head of the armed forces, while General Abdourahmane Abou Zataka steps in as the new army chief of staff. The changes come after Russian-backed forces assisted the government in suppressing a violent 24-hour uprising by soldiers last month.
amharic: በቅርቡ የተደረገው የአመፅ ሙከራ መንግስትን ከፈተነ በኋላ የኒጀር ወታደራዊ መንግስት ከፍተኛ የጦር አዛዦቹን መተካቱን አስታውቋል። ጄኔራል ማማኔ ሳኒኪያኡ አዲሱ የጦር ኃይሎች አዛዥ ሆነው የተሾሙ ሲሆን፣ ጄኔራል አብዱራህማን አቡ ዛታካ ደግሞ የአዲሱ ጦር ሰራዊት ዋና አዛዥ ሆነው ተሰይመዋል። ይህ ለውጥ የተደረገው ባለፈው ወር በወታደሮች የተካሄደውን የ24 ሰዓት አመፅ የሩሲያ ድጋፍ ባላቸው ኃይሎች በመታገዝ መንግስት ካከሸፈ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan waraana Niijer, kutaalee waraana isaa keessatti jijjiirraa guddaa gochuun ajajoota olaanoo isaa bakka buuseera. Murtii kanaan General Mamane Sani Kiaou ajajaa olaanaa waraana biyyattii ta'uun muudaman, General Abdourahmane Abou Zataka immoo ajajaa waraanaa ta'uun ramadamaniiru. Jijjiirraan kun kan dhufu, baatii darbe waraanni mootummaa irratti ka'ee ture humni deeggarsa Ruusiyaa qabu gargaaruun erga to'atamee booda.

title: Voting under way in Sweden election that could see far right enter gov’t
english: Swedish citizens are participating in a highly competitive general election that will determine whether the current center-left leadership remains in power or if the far-right Sweden Democrats join the government for the first time. The vote features a tight race between incumbent Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson’s conservative coalition and the opposition bloc led by Magdalena Andersson. Key campaign issues include the rising cost of living, immigration policies, and efforts to combat organized crime.
amharic: የስዊድን ህዝብ በሀገሪቱ የወደፊት የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ላይ የሚወስን ወሳኝ እና ከፍተኛ ፉክክር የታየበት ምርጫ እያካሄዱ ነው። ምርጫው አሁን በስልጣን ላይ ያለውን የመሀል-ግራ ዘመም መንግስት እና የቀኝ ዘመም ቡድኖችን እጣ ፈንታ የሚወስን ሲሆን፣ ይህም የጽንፈኛ ቀኝ አራማጁ 'ስዊድን ዲሞክራቶች' ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ መንግስት ስልጣን ሊገቡበት የሚችልበት እድል አለው። የኑሮ ውድነት፣ የስደተኞች ጉዳይ እና ወንጀልን የመከላከል ስራዎች በምርጫው ዋና ዋና መነጋገሪያ ጉዳዮች ሆነዋል።
oromo: Ummanni Swiidin filannoo biyyoolessa baay'ee wal-dorgomsiisaa ta'e irratti hirmaachaa jiru, kunis hoggansi amma jiru aangoo irra akka turu ykn gareen mirga-ol-aantummaa (far-right) yeroo jalqabaaf gara mootummaatti akka dhufu murteessa. Filannichi garee ministira duraanii Ulf Kristersson fi morkattoota Magdalena Andersson gidduutti kan taasifamu dha. Dhimmoonni gurguddoo filannoo kana keessatti ka'an gatii jireenyaa dabaluu, imaammata godaantotaa fi loola yakka gurmaa'e ittisuu dha.

title: Mosque and homes damaged in Saudi Arabia after alleged Houthi strike
english: Saudi Arabia reported that a projectile launched by Houthi rebels from Yemen damaged a local mosque and several residential buildings. While the Saudi authorities shared footage of the destruction, the Houthi group claimed their intended target was a nearby military installation. No casualties were mentioned in the reports regarding this cross-border attack.
amharic: የሳዑዲ አረቢያ ባለስልጣናት ከየመን በሁቲ አማፂያን የተተኮሰ ሚሳይል ወይም ፕሮጀክት መስጊድንና በርካታ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን ጉዳት እንዳደረሰ ገለፁ። ሁቲዎች በበኩላቸው ጥቃቱን ያደረሱት ወታደራዊ ጣቢያን ለማጥቃት መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። በደረሰው ጉዳት የሰው ህይወት ስለመጥፋቱ የተጠቀሰ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan ibsituun, meeshaan waraanaa gama Yaman irraa gara ishee dhukaafame, masjiida tokkoo fi manneen jireenyaa miidhuu isaa beeksisite. Gareen Hutiin gama isaatiin, meeshaan sun kan ittiin dhukaafame buufata waraanaa ishee naannichaa rukutuuf akka ta'e dubbateera. Haa ta'u malee, haleellaa kanaan namni du'e hin jiru.

title: Olympic flame arrives in Senegal for first ever Olympic event in Africa
english: The Olympic flame has officially landed in Senegal, signaling the beginning of preparations for the Youth Olympic Games. This historic event will mark the first time an Olympic competition is hosted on the African continent. The games are scheduled to take place this coming October.
amharic: የኦሎምፒክ ችቦ በሴኔጋል የደረሰ ሲሆን ይህም ለወጣቶች ኦሎምፒክ ጨዋታዎች የዝግጅት ጊዜ መጀመሩን ያሳያል። ይህ ታሪካዊ ክንውን በአፍሪካ አህጉር የመጀመሪያው የኦሎምፒክ ውድድር ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል። ጨዋታዎቹ በመጪው ጥቅምት ወር እንደሚካሄዱ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Ifaan Olompikii seenaa keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf Afrikaatti qopha'uuf jiru, tapha dargaggootaa ilaalchisee gara biyya Senegaal ga'eera. Taphoonni kunis ji'a Onkololeessa dhufu kana kan gaggeeffamu ta'a. Kunis Afrikaa keessatti waldorgommii Olompikii tokko akka qopha'u kan taasisu ta'a.

title: Mystery son and disputed heir: Uganda’s king buried amid succession dispute
english: Following the death of 34-year-old King Oyo of Uganda's Tooro kingdom, a significant power struggle has emerged regarding his successor. While royal clan elders have officially appointed Prince Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma to the throne, the late king’s immediate family insists that a secret, unrecognized son should be the heir based on a private will. This conflict highlights a deep divide between traditional leaders and the royal family over the legitimacy of the throne's future.
amharic: የዩጋንዳው ቶሮ መንግሥት ንጉሥ ኦዮ በ34 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት መለየታቸውን ተከትሎ፣ ቀጣዩን ንጉሥ በመሾም ሂደት ላይ ከፍተኛ አለመግባባት ተፈጥሯል። የንጉሣዊው ቤተሰብ ሽማግሌዎች ልዑል ኤድዋርድ ሩኪዲ ኪጃናንጎማን የዙፋኑ ተተኪ አድርገው ቢሾሙም፣ የሟቹ ንጉሥ ቤተሰቦች ግን ንጉሡ በኑዛዜያቸው መሰረት ህጋዊ ልጅ አላቸው በሚል ይህንን ውሳኔ ይቃወማሉ። ይህ ክስተት በባህላዊው የአመራር ምርጫ ሂደት እና በንጉሣዊ ቤተሰብ መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት አጋልጧል።
oromo: Mootichi mootummaa Tooroo kan Yugaandaa mootii Oyo umuriin isaanii 34 ta’e erga du’anii booda, bakka bu’aa isaanii ilaalchisee mormiin cimaan uumameera. Maanguddoonni gosa mootichaa mootummaa akka hogganuuf ilma obboleessa mootichaa kan ta’an Edwaardi Rukidii Kijanangomaa filatanis, maatiin mootichaa garuu ijoollee mootichaa kan ta’e fi namoonni hedduun hin beekne tokko dhaaltuu ta’uu qaba jedhanii mormaa jiru. Walitti bu’iinsi kun aadaa fi sirna bulchiinsa mootummaa akkasumas yaada maatii mootichaa gidduutti garaagarummaan uumamuu isaa mul’isa.

title: Israeli strike kills two Palestinians in Gaza City
english: An Israeli military strike on a vehicle in Gaza City’s Tal al-Hawa neighborhood resulted in the deaths of two Palestinians and left several others wounded. This recent attack adds to the rising casualty figures in Gaza, where thousands have been killed since October 2023. Current reports indicate that the total number of victims in the ongoing conflict has now surpassed 73,000 deaths.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በታል አል-ሃዋ ሰፈር በእስራኤል ኃይሎች በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የተገደሉ ሰዎችን ቁጥር ወደ 73,783 ከፍ አድርጎታል። በግጭቱ ምክንያት እስካሁን ከ174 ሺህ በላይ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel magaalaa Gaazaatti konkolaataa tokko irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiiseen namootni Palastinyoota lama ajjeefamaniiru, kanneen biroos miidhamaniiru. Hojiin waraanaa kun ji'a Onkololeessa 2023 irraa eegalee biyyattii keessatti namoota kuma 73 ol lubbuun isaanii akka darbu godheera. Waliigalatti, hanga ammaatti namootni kuma 174 ol ta'an miidhaa gara garaatiif saaxilamaniiru.

title: Israel launches new air attacks on southern Lebanon
english: The Israeli military conducted several airstrikes in southern Lebanon on Sunday, specifically targeting areas near Nabatieh and Kfar Tebnit. According to reports, the strikes occurred in quick succession during the morning. These military actions continue the ongoing regional tensions in the border area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል እሁድ ዕለት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ የናባቲያ እና የክፋር ተብኒት አካባቢዎች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። ዘገባዎች እንደሚያመለክቱት ጥቃቶቹ በአጭር ጊዜ ልዩነት ውስጥ ተደጋግመው ተካሂደዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በድንበር አካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el Dilbata darbe kibba Libaanoos keessatti bakkeewwan Nabatiiyaa fi Kfaar Tebniit jedhamanitti haleellaa qilleensaa raawwateera. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, haleellaawwan kunneen yeroo gabaabaa keessatti walitti aansuun kan raawwataman dha. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa naannoo daangaa sanaa keessatti mul'achaa jiru kan cimsudha.

title: Yemen government forces say they shot down five Houthi drones
english: Yemeni government forces successfully intercepted five drones launched by Houthi rebels in the al-Aghbara region. In a separate operation, government military aircraft carried out strikes against Houthi positions throughout the country. These airstrikes resulted in the destruction of military equipment and several enemy casualties.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ሃይሎች በአል-አግባራ አካባቢ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የተላኩ አምስት ድሮኖችን መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ የመንግስት አየር ኃይል በተለያዩ የሀገሪቱ ክፍሎች በሚገኙ የሁቲ ኢላማዎች ላይ የአየር ድብደባዎችን አድርጓል። በእነዚህ ጥቃቶች የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ወታደራዊ መሣሪያዎች የወደሙ ሲሆን ቁጥራቸው በውል ያልተገለጸ ታጣቂዎችም ተገድለዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman naannoo Al-Aghbaraatti xiyyara malee kan ta’an shan kan garee Huutii rukutanii kuffisuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Kana malees, xiyyaroonni waraana mootummaa bakkeewwan adda addaatti argaman irratti haleellaa qilleensaa gaggeessaniiru. Haleellaa kanaan meeshaaleen waraanaa garee Huutii kan barbadaa’an yoo ta’u, waraanni isaanii muraasni du’uunis gabaafameera.

title: Morning recap
english: The Middle East is facing heightened instability following a series of maritime incidents, including an attack on an Iranian vessel near Qeshm Island and reports of projectile strikes in the Strait of Hormuz. Regional tensions are further escalated by Houthi military actions against Saudi Arabia and a ongoing US naval blockade. Meanwhile, Palestinian territory has seen violent settler raids, while thousands of refugees are fleeing conflict-ridden Yemen for safety in Djibouti.
amharic: በኢራን መርከብ ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት እና በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ የተመዘገቡ የጦር መሳሪያ ድብደባዎችን ተከትሎ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ውጥረት ተባብሷል። በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ በሁቲዎች የተሰነዘረው ጥቃት እና የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ማዕቀብ ቀጠናውን የበለጠ አሳሳቢ አድርጎታል። በሌላ በኩል በዌስት ባንክ ሰፋሪዎች በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ ጥቃት እየፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የመንያውያን ስደተኞችም ወደ ጅቡቲ እየገቡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hangaahuu baha giddugaleessaatti haleellaa doonii Iraan fi naannoo garba Hormuzitti mudateen walqabatee rakkoon nageenyaa dabalaa jira. Gochaan waraanaa Hutiin Saudii Arabiyaarratti raawwatan fi uggurri galaana US naannichatti labsame tasgabbii dhabsiiseera. Gamasa biraatin, lafa Palastiin keessatti weerara jiraattotaan miidhaan qaqqabaa jiraachuu fi baqattoonni Yaman kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman gara Jibuutii godaanuu gabaafameera.

title: Several Palestinians detained, two injured during raids by Israeli forces, settlers
english: Israeli forces and settlers conducted multiple raids across the West Bank and East Jerusalem, leading to numerous arrests and several injuries. The operations involved the detention of residents, including minors, as well as the destruction of property and the disruption of local movement. These incidents have further escalated tensions in the region, affecting various towns and villages.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች እና ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ እና በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም ባካሄዱት ተከታታይ ወረራ በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ታስረዋል፤ ሌሎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በዘመቻው ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሰዎች የታሰሩ ሲሆን የንብረት ውድመት እና የመንገድ መዘጋጋት ተከስቷል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በተለያዩ የፍልስጤም ከተሞች እና መንደሮች ውጥረትን አባብሰዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'eelifi qubattoonni naannoo West Bankiifi Yerusaalem Bahaa keessatti duula gaggeessaniin lammiileen Falasxiin hedduun hidhamaniiru, kaanis madaa'aniiru. Duula kanaan ijoollee dabalatee namoonni baay'een qabamanii jiran, akkasumas qabeenyi manca'ee, tajaajilli daandii gufatee jira. Gochootni kunneen magaaloofi baadiyyaa Falasxiin keessatti dhiphinaafi waldhabdee hammaachisaa jiru.

title: They lost their jobs after posting about Charlie Kirk, but some have no regrets
english: Gerald Bourguet lost his job as a basketball journalist after posting critical comments about the late conservative activist Charlie Kirk following his death. His online remarks went viral, leading to his termination, harassment, and the need to relocate his young family for their safety. Although he is now forced to rebuild his life from scratch, Bourguet maintains that he does not regret expressing his opinions despite the severe personal consequences.
amharic: ጄራልድ ቡርጌት የተባለ ስፖርታዊ ጋዜጠኛ፣ ወግ አጥባቂው አክቲቪስት ቻርሊ ኪርክ መገደሉን ተከትሎ በሰጠው አስተያየት ከስራው ተባረረ። አስተያየቱ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መሰራጨቱን ተከትሎ ከስራው መባረሩ ብቻ ሳይሆን፣ ለደህንነቱ በመስጋት ከቤተሰቡ ጋር ለመሰደድ ተገዷል። ምንም እንኳን ህይወቱን ከባዶ ለመጀመር ቢገደድም፣ የገለጸውን ሀሳብ እንደማይጸጸት ይናገራል።
oromo: Gerald Bourguet jedhamu gaazexeessaa kubbaa basketbolii kan ture, du'a guddicha konservativii Charlie Kirk hordofee yaada isaa erga ibsee booda hojii isaarraa ari'ame. Yaanni inni intarneetiirra barreessse saffisaan waan babal'ateef, hojii isaa dhabuu qofa osoo hin ta'in, nageenya maatii isaatiif jecha bakka jireenyaa jijjiirrachuuf dirqame. Amma jireenya isaa irra deebi'ee jalqabuuf dirqamus, miidhaa isa mudate hundaatuu yaada inni ibsateef akka hin gaabbin dubbata.

title: Wildfire rages on Croatia’s Dalmatian Coast island of Brac
english: A dangerous wildfire has broken out on the island of Brac, located off the coast of Croatia. Emergency responders are struggling to control the flames near the village of Milna due to intense winds. Authorities have raised an emergency alert as the situation remains critical.
amharic: በክሮኤሺያ የዳልማቲያን የባህር ዳርቻ በሚገኘው የብራክ ደሴት ላይ አደገኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ተቀስቅሷል። በኃይለኛ ንፋስ ምክንያት ሚልና በተባለው መንደር አቅራቢያ የሚገኘውን እሳት ለመቆጣጠር የሚደረገው ጥረት ተቸግሯል። ሁኔታው አስቸጋሪ በመሆኑ ባለስልጣናት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ማስጠንቀቂያ አስተላልፈዋል።
oromo: Odola Biraach jedhamtu tan qarqara galaana Krooshiyaatti argamtu irratti ibidde guddaan ka'eera. Bubbee cimaa jiruun kan ka'e, ibidda ganduma Milnaa jedhamu bira jiru dhaamsuun humni ittisa balaa irratti rakkachaa jira. Haalli kun yaaddessaa waan ta'eef, aangessonni biyyattii akeekkachiisa hatattamaa dabarsaniiru.

title: One dead, more than 30 missing after Vanuatu ferry sinks, PM’s office says
english: A ferry named MV Matui sank during harsh weather while traveling between two islands in Vanuatu, leaving at least one person dead and over 30 others missing. Although 15 people have been rescued, authorities are shifting their search efforts toward the coast due to current patterns. The government believes the tragedy may have been caused by ignoring weather warnings and potential overcrowding, and a full investigation is now underway.
amharic: በቫኑአቱ በሁለት ደሴቶች መካከል ይጓዝ የነበረው ኤምቪ ማቱይ የተባለ መርከብ በመጥፎ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት ሰምጦ ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው መሞቱን እና ከ30 በላይ ሰዎች መጥፋታቸውን መንግስት አስታውቋል። እስካሁን 15 ሰዎች በህይወት ቢገኙም፣ የነፍስ አድን ቡድኑ ፍለጋውን ወደ ባህር ዳርቻዎች አሸጋግሯል። አደጋው የደረሰው የአየር ሁኔታ ማስጠንቀቂያዎችን ባለማክበር እና መርከቡ ከመጠን በላይ በመጫኑ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Markabii 'MV Matui' jedhamu kan giddudduu odola lamaan gidduutti imalaa ture, qilleensa hamaa hordofee bishaan keessatti lixuu isaa hordofee namni tokko yoo du'u, namoonni 30 ol immoo badee jira. Namoonni 15 lubbuun kan argaman yoo ta'u, barbaacha isaa gara qarqara galaanaatti giddudduu godhataniiru. Rakkoon kun kan dhufe akeekkachiisa qilleensaatiin ala deemuu fi markabicha baayyisanii fe'uu irraa ta'uu akka danda'u mootummaan ibsee qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira.

title: Yemen’s Houthis seize strategic Mayun Island in Red Sea
english: The Houthi rebels in Yemen have taken control of Mayun Island, a vital location situated in the Red Sea. This move strengthens their influence over the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, a key maritime trade route. Additionally, the group has reportedly secured significant amounts of American military equipment.
amharic: የየመኑ የሁቲ አማፂ ቡድን በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ የምትገኘውን ስትራቴጂካዊዋን ማዩን ደሴት ተቆጣጥረዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር መስመርን ለመቆጣጠር የሚያስችላቸውን አቅም ይበልጥ ያጠናክራል። በተጨማሪም ቡድኑ ከፍተኛ ዋጋ ያላቸውን አሜሪካ ሰራሽ ወታደራዊ መሳርያዎች መውረሱ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humni fincilaa Huutii kan Yaman, magaalaa bakka tarsiimawaa taate kan taate ganda Maayuun kan galaana diimaa keessatti argamtu toannoo isaa jala oolcheera. Tarkaanfiin kun karaa daldala galaanaa kan taate Baab al-Maandeb toachuuf isaan gargaara. Kana malees, gareen kun meeshaalee waraanaa Ameerikaan oomishaman kan gatiin isaanii baay'ee ol'aanaa ta'e booji'uu isaa gabaasameera.

title: ‘We started to plummet’: Turbulence rocks Turkish Airlines flight
english: A Turkish Airlines flight headed to Tunisia experienced intense turbulence that caused panic among passengers. After failing to land at its original destination three times, the aircraft was forced to divert to a different airport. Travelers described the experience as frightening, noting that the plane appeared to drop rapidly during the final landing attempt.
amharic: ወደ ቱኒዚያ ይበር የነበረ የቱርክ አየር መንገድ አውሮፕላን ከፍተኛ የአየር ሁኔታ መዛባት በማጋጠሙ ተሳፋሪዎች ከፍተኛ ፍርሃት ውስጥ ገብተው ነበር። አውሮፕላኑ ወደ መዳረሻው ለማረፍ ሶስት ጊዜ ቢሞክርም ሳይሳካለት ቀርቶ ወደ ሌላ አየር ማረፊያ እንዲያርፍ ተደርጓል። ተሳፋሪዎች በተለይም በመጨረሻው ሙከራ ወቅት አውሮፕላኑ ድንገተኛ መውረድ እንደገጠመው በመግለጽ የነበረውን አስፈሪ ሁኔታ አስታውሰዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri Turkish Airlines gara biyya Tuniiziyaa imalaa ture bubbee cimaan mudachuu isaatiin imaltoota gidduutti rifatuun uumamee ture. Xiyyaarichi buufata isaa kan jalqabaa irratti yeroo sadii qubachuuf yaalii godhe illee milka’uu waan dadhabeef, gara buufata biraatti akka geeddaramu taasifame. Imaltoonni yaalii qubachuu isa dhumaa irratti xiyyaarichi tasa gadi bu’uu isaa ibsuun, muuxannoo baay’ee nama rifachiisu akka ta’e dubbataniiru.

title: Iraq seizes drone-launching platform used for targeting Saudi oil pipeline
english: Iraqi security forces have discovered and confiscated a drone-launching base in the southeastern Maysan province that was used to target a major Saudi oil pipeline. Following the strike, which caused injuries and forced a temporary shutdown of the pipeline, Iraqi officials are working with Saudi Arabia to investigate the incident. The Iraqi government has stated it will not allow its territory to be used as a platform for regional attacks and has allowed Iran to join the investigation as the search for the perpetrators continues.
amharic: የኢራቅ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር ጥቅም ላይ የዋለ ድሮን ማስጀመሪያ ጣቢያ በኢራቅ ደቡብ ምስራቅ ግዛት ማይሳን ማግኘታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቱ ጉዳት ማድረሱን ተከትሎ የነዳጅ መስመሩ ለጊዜው እንዲዘጋ የተደረገ ሲሆን የኢራቅ መንግስት ከሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት ጋር በመተባበር ምርመራ እያካሄደ ነው። የኢራቅ መንግስት ሀገሩ ለጎረቤት ሀገራት ጥቃት ማድረሻ መድረክ ሆና እንድትቀጥል እንደማይፈቅድ ገልጾ፣ ኢራን በምርመራው እንድትሳተፍ ፈቃድ ሰጥቷል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Iraaq, daandii boba'aa Saudii Arabiyaa irratti weerara raawwachuuf gargaaraa ture, dirree xiyyaaraa fagoorraa to'atamu (drones) godina Maysaan kibba-baha Iraaq keessatti argachuun isaanii beekameera. Weerara kanaan miidhaan qaqqabee fi daandiin boba'ichaa yeroof akka cufamu taasifameera; mootummaan Iraaqis gama isaanitiin Saudii Arabiyaa waliin ta'uun qorannoo geggeessaa jiru. Iraaq biyyi ishee bakka weeraraa kan biraa itti raawwatamu akka hin taane ibsuun, qorannoo kana keessatti Iran akka hirmaattu hayyamteetti.

title: Ethiopia’s Future Demands Axum–Harar Synergy
english: Ethiopia's rich civilization was shaped by the parallel development of two major centers: Axum in the Christian north and Harar in the Islamic east. While Axum is globally recognized for its ancient architecture and royal history, the eastern regions contributed significantly through trade, urban scholarship, and international connections. Together with the diverse contributions of other communities like the Oromo, these two hubs demonstrate that the nation is a product of multiple historical threads rather than a single tradition.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ሥልጣኔ በሁለት ዋና ዋና የዕድገት ማዕከላት ጥምረት የተገነባ ነው፤ እነርሱም በሰሜን የነበረው የአክሱም ክርስቲያናዊ ሥርዓት እና በምስራቅ የነበረው የሐረር እስላማዊ የከተማ ሥልጣኔ ናቸው። አክሱም በአስደናቂ ቅርሶቿ እና በታሪኳ ትልቅ ቦታ ቢኖራትም፣ ሐረርም በንግድ፣ በትምህርት እና በዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነቶች ለሀገሪቱ እድገት ትልቅ ድርሻ አበርክታለች። እነዚህ ሁለት ማዕከላት እንደ ኦሮሞ እና ሌሎች ብሔረሰቦች አስተዋፅዖ ጋር በመደመር ኢትዮጵያን የብዙ ታሪካዊ መስተጋብሮች ውጤት አድርገዋታል።
oromo: Siivilizeeshinii Itiyoophiyaa kan ijaare bu’uura Axum fi Harar irratti kan hundaa’eefi gamtaadhaan kan gabbatedha. Axum seenaa fi ijaarsa duriitiin beekamti, Hararimmoo daldalaa fi barnoota Islaamaa irraa kaasee hanga quunnamtii alaa fi magaala-bulchiinsaatti gahee olaanaa qabdi. Akkasumas, sirnoonni akka Gadaa fi aadaaleen uummattoota biroo waliigalaa biyyattiin guddinaa fi duudhaa hedduu kan qabdu ta’uu mirkaneessu. Kanaafuu, seenaan Itiyoophiyaa bakka tokko qofa osoo hin taane, waliigaltee fi hariiroo aadaa gara garaa kan irraa burquudha.

title: A WILDFLOWER TAMED INTO PLASTIC
english: As the Ethiopian New Year approaches, Shola Market is filled with artificial replicas of the iconic Adey Abeba flower. These handcrafted decorations are used to brighten homes and create festive accessories like headbands and glasses. Artisans are keeping the spirit of the holiday alive by selling these plastic versions of the traditional yellow bloom to festive shoppers.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ አዲስ ዓመት እየቀረበ ሲመጣ፣ የሸዋ ገበያ በታዋቂው የአደይ አበባ ሰው ሰራሽ ቅጂዎች ተጥለቅልቋል። እነዚህ በእጅ የተሰሩ አበባዎች ቤቶችን ለማስጌጥ እና እንደ የራስ ማሰሪያ እና መነጽር ባሉ የዓሉ መገልገያዎች ላይ ያገለግላሉ። የእጅ ጥበብ ባለሙያዎች ባህላዊውን ቢጫ አበባ በፕላስቲክ በመስራት ለበዓል ገበያተኞች በማቅረብ የበዓሉን ድባብ በገበያው ውስጥ አንፀባርቀዋል።
oromo: Ayyaanri waggaa haaraa Itoophiyaa yeroo dhiyaatu, gabaan Sholaa gosa abaaboo 'Adey Abeba' kan suuraan ishee tolfamee hojjetamee dhiyaateen guutameera. Abaaboon kun manaa fi qaama miidhagsiisuuf akka akkasumas akka cuuccuubbee fi goggooraa faayaa ta'ee ni fayyada. Ogeeyyiin hojii harka qananii abaaboo bifa keelloo qabu kana boca garaagaraan tolfanii gabaatti dhiyeessuun gammachuu ayyaanichaa dabalaa jiru.

title: Paying More, Receiving Less, as New Year Squeeze Reaches Markets
english: As the New Year approaches, Ethiopian households are struggling with a severe decline in purchasing power due to rising costs. Families are finding that they must spend significantly more money just to afford smaller amounts of basic holiday goods. This economic pressure reflects a broader trend of inflation impacting the daily lives and festive traditions of many citizens.
amharic: የአዲስ ዓመት በዓል እየተቃረበ ባለበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ የኑሮ ውድነት የብዙ ኢትዮጵያውያን የገዢነት አቅም ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ነው። ቤተሰቦች ለበዓል የሚፈልጓቸውን መሰረታዊ ቁሳቁሶች ለማግኘት ከበፊቱ በበለጠ ከፍተኛ ወጪ ማውጣት ቢገባቸውም፣ የሚገዙት እቃ መጠን ግን እጅግ ቀንሷል። ይህ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና የብዙ ዜጎችን የዕለት ተዕለት ኑሮና የበዓል አከባበር ባህል እየፈተነ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ayyaanni haaraan yommuu dhiyaatutti, gatiin jireenyaa fi dabaluun gatii gabaa maatiiwwan Itoophiyaa hedduu irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumee jira. Maatiiwwan mi'oota ayyaanaaf barbaachisan bituuf kanaan duraa ol baasii guddaa baasuun kan isaan irra jiraatu ta'us, meeshaan isaan bitan garuu baay'inaan xiqqaa dha. Dhiibbaan diinagdee kun jireenya guyyaa guyyaa fi aadaa ayyaaneffannaa lammiilee hedduu irratti qormaata cimaa ta'eera.

title: Agri Officials Bet Billions of Dollars on Sorghum, with Farmers Carrying Most
english: The Ethiopian federal government is launching a massive 2.93 billion dollar initiative to expand sorghum production and processing by 2030. While the plan aims to repurpose this drought-resistant crop for feed, flour, and brewing, the majority of the financial burden falls on smallholder farmers. Only a small fraction of the total funding is covered by the government and private sector combined.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ፌዴራል መንግስት እስከ 2030 ዓ.ም ድረስ የሚቆይ የ2.93 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሾርን ምርት እና ማቀነባበሪያ ፕሮጀክት ሊጀምር ነው። ይህ እቅድ ድርቅን የመቋቋም አቅም ያለውን ሰብል ለእንስሳት መኖ፣ ለዱቄት እና ለቢራ ጠመቃ ለመጠቀም ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ አብዛኛው የገንዘብ ጫና የሚወድቀው በአርሶ አደሮች ላይ ነው። የመንግስት እና የግል ዘርፍ ድርሻ ከጠቅላላው በጀት ውስጥ በጣም አነስተኛ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan federaalaa Itoophiyaa hanga bara 2030tti kan turu pirojekti qonnaa fi qophii mishingaa kan kaffaltiin isaa biliyoona 2.93 ga’u jalqabuuf qophii irra jira. Karoorri kun mishingaa, midhaan hongee dandamatu, gabaa fedhii foonii, daakuu fi oomisha biraatiif oolchuuf kan yaadame yoo ta’u, ba’iin maallaqaa guddaan garuu qonnaan bultoota irratti kan kufuu dha. Gumaachi mootummaa fi qooddattoota dhuunfaa baajata waliigalaa keessatti baay’ee xiqqoo dha.

title: A Deadline Passes, Two Dozen Private Colleges Wait on a Verdict
english: The Ethiopian Education & Training Authority has officially ended a one-year grace period for 25 private higher education institutions to complete their re-registration requirements. Colleges that failed to submit the necessary documentation by the deadline will have their licenses revoked and be removed from the system. Authorities are now conducting onsite inspections to verify compliance, affecting several prominent private universities.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የትምህርትና ስልጠና ባለስልጣን ለ25 የግል ከፍተኛ ትምህርት ተቋማት የሰጠው የአንድ ዓመት የምዝገባ ማሻሻያ ጊዜ መጠናቀቁን አስታውቋል። በተቀመጠው የጊዜ ገደብ ውስጥ አስፈላጊውን ሰነድ ያላቀረቡ ተቋማት ፈቃዳቸው እንደተሰረዘ ተቆጥረው ከስርዓቱ ውጭ እንደሚሆኑ ባለስልጣኑ ገልጿል። ባለስልጣኑ በአሁኑ ወቅት የቅድመ ምረቃ እና የድህረ ምረቃ ተቋማትን አፈጻጸም በአካል በመገኘት የማጣራት ስራ እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa barnootaa fi leenjii Itoophiyaa, dhaabbileen barnoota olaanoo dhuunfaa 25 galmee isaanii akka haaromfatan kenneef ture xumuramuu beeksiseera. Dhaabbileen yeroo kennameef keessatti sanada barbaachisu dhiheeffachuu dadhaban, hayyamni isaanii kan haqamu ta'uu fi sirnichaa ala kan ta'an ta'uu ibsameera. Abbootiin taayitaa kun yeroo ammaa dhaabbilee kanneen irratti hordoffii fi qulqulleeffannaa godhaa jiru.

title: A Soap Trademark Fight Ends in Damages Pay
english: The Federal High Court has ruled against Dafa Soap & Detergent Manufacturing Plc in a trademark dispute involving its AZZY product line. The company must cease production, remove its products from the market, and pay 24 million Birr in damages to the plaintiff, Ahmed Nuredin Abdela. This decision concludes a four-year legal battle, marking the third time the court has ruled in favor of the plaintiff.
amharic: የፌዴራል ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ዳፋ ሶፕ ኤንድ ዲተርጀንት ማኑፋክቸሪንግ ኃላፊነቱ የተወሰነ የግል ማህበር የንግድ ምልክትን ባለመብት በመጣሱ ጥፋተኛ ሆኖ እንዲገኝ ወስኗል። ኩባንያው የAZZY ምርቶቹን ማምረትና ማስታወቂያ መስራት እንዲያቆም፣ ያሉትንም ምርቶች ከገበያ እንዲሰበስብ እና ለባለቤቱ ለአህመድ ኑረዲን አብደላ 24 ሚሊዮን ብር ካሳ እንዲከፍል ታዟል። ይህ ውሳኔ በአራት ዓመታት የህግ ክርክር የፍርድ ቤቱን የመጨረሻ ውሳኔ ያረጋገጠ ነው።
oromo: Mana Murtii Ol'aanaa Federaalaatti, dhaabbanni Dafa Soap & Detergent Manufacturing Plc mirga wabummaa mallattoo daldalaa (trademark) AZZY jedhu sarbuun isaa erga mirkanaa'ee booda adabbiin irratti darbeera. Dhaabbanni kun oomisha isaa akka dhaabu, oomishaalee gabaa irra jiran akka kaasuufi badhaasa qarshii miiliyoona 24 kaffaluuf dirqamisiifameera. Murtii kanaanis, giddiraa waggaa afur ture xumura argateera.

title: Mbappe double helps Real Madrid thump Rayo Vallecano 4–1 in La Liga
english: Kylian Mbappe scored two goals to lead Real Madrid to a dominant 4-1 victory over Rayo Vallecano in La Liga. Other goals from Jude Bellingham and Alvaro Carreras helped the team bounce back from a recent league defeat. This win moves Real Madrid into a tie for first place with Barcelona in the current league standings.
amharic: ኪሊያን ምባፔ ሁለት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር ሪያል ማድሪድ ራዮ ቫሌካኖን 4 ለ 1 በሆነ ውጤት እንዲያሸንፍ አስችሎታል። ከጁድ ቤሊንጋም እና ከአልቫሮ ካሬራስ በተቆጠሩ ተጨማሪ ግቦች ቡድኑ ካለፈው የሊግ ሽንፈት አገግሞ ወደ ድል መመለስ ችሏል። ይህ ድል ሪያል ማድሪድን በላሊጋው የደረጃ ሰንጠረዥ ከባርሴሎና ጋር እኩል በሆነ ነጥብ አንደኛ ደረጃ ላይ አስቀምጦታል።
oromo: Kiliyaam Maappe qabxii lama galchuun Real Maadiriid garee Raayoo Vaalleekaanoo irratti injifannoo guddaa 4-1 ta'e akka gonfatu gargaareera. Galchiiwwan Jood Beelingaam fi Alvaaro Kaareeraas irraa argamaniin, garen kun tapha liigii darbe irratti erga injifatameen booda deebi'anii milkaa'aniiru. Injifannoon kunis Real Maadiriid taphataan Baarseloonaa wajjin qabxii walfakkaataa qabaachuun sadarkaa duraa irratti akka argamu taasiseera.

title: Alexander Zverev vs Ben Shelton: US Open men’s singles final – all to know
english: Top-seeded Alexander Zverev will compete against American rising star Ben Shelton in the 2026 US Open men's singles final this Sunday. Shelton is aiming to become the first American man to win a Grand Slam title in 23 years, while the experienced Zverev seeks his second major championship of the year. The high-stakes match will take place at the Arthur Ashe Stadium in New York.
amharic: የዘንድሮው የዩኤስ ኦፕን የወንዶች የፍጻሜ ውድድር በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ተሰላፊው አሌክሳንደር ዝቬሬቭ እና በአሜሪካዊው ወጣት ተጫዋች ቤን ሼልተን መካከል እሁድ ይካሄዳል። ቤን ሼልተን ከ23 ዓመታት በኋላ የአሜሪካን የግራንድ ስላም ድል ለማስመዝገብ ሲጥር፣ ዝቬሬቭ ደግሞ በውድድር ዘመኑ ሁለተኛውን የዋንጫ ድል ለማግኘት ይጫወታል። ይህ ወሳኝ ጨዋታ በኒውዮርክ በሚገኘው አርተር አሽ ስታዲየም ይከናወናል።
oromo: Dorgommii xumuraa dhiirota US Open bara 2026 irratti, taphattoota sadarkaa olaanaa qaban kan ta'an Aleksander Zverev fi biyyaattiin keenya Ben Sheeltan Dilbata dhufu wal morkatu. Sheeltan waggaa 23 booda lammiin Ameerikaa tokko Shaampiyoonaa Giraandi Silaam akka ta'uuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru, Zverev ammoo waancaa isa lammaffaa bara kanaa fudhachuuf falmata. Qophiin kunis New Yorkitti, buufata Arthur Ashe Stadium irratti kan taasifamu ta'a.

title: Elena Rybakina defeats Aryna Sabalenka in US Open women’s singles final
english: Elena Rybakina claimed her third Grand Slam title by defeating Aryna Sabalenka in the US Open women’s singles final. Despite struggling with a prior ankle injury, Rybakina remained calm throughout the match to win in three sets. This victory marks a significant achievement for the Kazakh player, as she officially reaches the world number one ranking.
amharic: ኤሌና ሪባኪና በአሜሪካ ኦፕን የሴቶች የፍጻሜ ውድድር አሪና ሳባሌንካን በማሸነፍ ሶስተኛዋን የግራንድ ስላም ዋንጫ ማንሳት ችላለች። ቀደም ሲል የነበረባትን የቁርጭምጭሚት ጉዳት በመቋቋም የተረጋጋ ብቃት ያሳየችው ሪባኪና፣ ጨዋታውን በሶስት ሴቶች አሸንፋለች። ይህ ድል የካዛኪስታኗን ተጫዋች በዓለም ደረጃ አንደኛ ደረጃ ላይ እንድትቀመጥ ያስቻላት ትልቅ ስኬት ነው።
oromo: Elena Rybakina morkattuu ishee Aryna Sabalenka injifachuun waancaa US Open yeroo sadaffeef kaasuun injifannoo guddaa galmeessiteetti. Miidhaa faana ishee irra ture ilaalcha keessa galchuun, Rybakina tasgabbii olaanaadhaan taphicha injifatteetti. Injifannoon kun taphattuu Kaazaakistaan tanaaf sadarkaa tokkoffaa addunyaa irratti akka argattu kan gargaare yoo ta'u, milkaa'ina guddaa isheeti.

title: Arteta seethes at Sunderland penalty decision despite Arsenal win
english: Arsenal continued their perfect start to the Premier League season with a 2-0 victory over Sunderland, keeping them at the top of the table. Despite the win, manager Mikel Arteta was furious with the referee's decision to grant Sunderland a penalty, calling it unacceptable and unfair. Goals from Bruno Guimaraes and Bukayo Saka secured the result, while goalkeeper David Raya's crucial penalty save helped the team maintain their strong defensive record.
amharic: አርሰናል የፕሪሚየር ሊግ የውድድር ዘመኑን ፍጹም በሆነ አጀማመር በመቀጠል ሰንደርላንድን 2 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ በሊጉ አናት ላይ መቀመጥ ችሏል። በድሉ ቢደሰቱም፣ የአርሰናል አሰልጣኝ ሚኬል አርቴታ ለሰንደርላንድ የተሰጠውን የፍፁም ቅጣት ምት ተቀባይነት የለውም በማለት በዳኛው ውሳኔ ላይ ከፍተኛ ቁጣቸውን ገልጸዋል። የብሩኖ ጊማሬስ እና የቡካዮ ሳካ ግቦች ድሉን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ ግብ ጠባቂው ዳቪድ ራያ ያዳነው የፍፁም ቅጣት ምት ቡድኑን ከሽንፈት በመታደግ ጠንካራ የመከላከል አቅማቸውን እንዲያሳዩ ረድቷቸዋል።
oromo: Arsenal injifannoo 2-0 Sunderland irratti galchuun, jalqaba seenaa Premier League isaanii kan kanaan duraa itti fufsiisanii fi sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamu. Injifannoo kana boodas, leenjisaan Arsenal Mikel Arteta murtee abbaa firdii Sunderlandif kenname irratti aariin guddaan itti dhagaahamee, murtee kana fudhatama kan hin qabne jedheera. Galchiiwwan Bruno Guimaraes fi Bukayo Saka injifannoo kana mirkaneessan; qabxiin golaa David Raya inni muraasni kunis goolii akka itti hin lakkofneefis gargaareera.

title: Tens of thousands march across Germany to protest far-right party AfD
english: Across Germany, approximately 150,000 citizens participated in widespread demonstrations to express opposition to the far-right party AfD. These protests were sparked by the party's significant electoral success in Saxony-Anhalt, raising concerns about the potential for a far-right group to lead a German state government for the first time since 1945. Activists and concerned citizens are now calling for a formal ban on the party to protect democratic institutions.
amharic: በጀርመን በመላው አገሪቱ በተካሄዱ ሰልፎች ወደ 150,000 የሚጠጉ ዜጎች የአክራሪው ቀኝ አክራሪ ፓርቲ የሆነውን AfD በመቃወም ድምፃቸውን አሰምተዋል። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች የተቀሰቀሱት ፓርቲው በሳክሶኒ-አንሃልት ግዛት ባገኘው ከፍተኛ የምርጫ ድል ሳቢያ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ከ1945 በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ቀኝ አክራሪ ቡድን የጀርመን ግዛት መንግስትን የመምራት ዕድል አለው የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል። አክቲቪስቶች እና ተቃዋሚዎች የዴሞክራሲ ስርዓቱን ለመጠበቅ ፓርቲው በህግ እንዲታገድ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Jarmanii keessatti namoonni 150,000 ol ta'an, paartii gama mirgaa (far-right) kan ta'e AfD mormuun hiriira bal'aa gaggeessaniiru. Mormiin kun kan ka'e, paartiin kun naannoo Saaksanii-Anhaalt keessatti injifannoo guddaa argachuu isaa hordofee yoo ta'u, kunis bara 1945 booda yeroo jalqabaaf gareen gama mirgaa mootummaa naannoo tokko bulchu danda'a jechuun yaaddoo uumeera. Namoonni hiriira ba'an kunneen, sirna dimokiraasii biyyattii eeguuf jecha paartichi akka dhorkamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Centcom says US forces redirected 100 ships during ongoing blockade
english: The U.S. Central Command reported that its forces have diverted 100 commercial ships over the last two months as part of an active naval blockade against Iran. Military officials stated that no vessels have successfully crossed the zone without explicit authorization. American troops continue to maintain strict oversight to ensure the effectiveness of this ongoing mission.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም ባለፉት ሁለት ወራት ውስጥ በኢራን ላይ የጣለውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ ተከትሎ 100 የንግድ መርከቦችን ማዘዋወሩን አስታውቋል። የጦር ኃይሉ ያለ ምንም ፍቃድ አንድም መርከብ እገዳውን አልፎ እንዳልሄደ ገልጿል። የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ይህንን ተልእኮ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ለማስፈጸም ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ajajni giddu galeessa waraana Amerikaa (Centcom) ji'oota lamaan darban keessa markaboota daldalaa 100 gara biraatti akka geesse beeksiseera. Kunis dhorkaa waraanaa irra deddeebi'ee Iran irratti godhame kan hordofudha. Waraanni Amerikaa markabni tokkollee eeyyama malee daangaa kana akka hin qaxxamurre ibseera.

title: Araghchi, Iraqi foreign minister stress security along shared borders
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein held a phone call to discuss regional security and border cooperation. Both officials emphasized the need to avoid escalating regional conflicts and to maintain stability. This conversation follows a recent border closure in Iraq after a drone attack impacted regional oil infrastructure.
amharic: የኢራኑ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ እና የኢራቁ አቻቸው ፋውድ ሁሴን በስልክ ባደረጉት ንግግር ስለ ቀጠናው ደህንነት እና ድንበር ተሻጋሪ ትብብር ተወያይተዋል። ሁለቱ ወገኖች በክልሉ ውስጥ የሚፈጠሩ ግጭቶች እንዳይስፋፉና መረጋጋት እንዲሰፍን በጋራ መስራት እንደሚያስፈልግ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ውይይት የተካሄደው በኢራቅ ድንበር አካባቢ የድሮን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ድንበሮች ከተዘጉ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araghchi fi ministirri dhimma alaa Iraaq Fuad Hussein bilbilaan mari'achuun nageenya naannichaa fi walitti dhufeenya daangaa irratti yaada waljijjiiraniiru. Gareen lamaanuu waldhabdeen naannichaa akka hin babal'anne fi tasgabbiin akka jiraatu waliigaluun isaanii ibsameera. Mariin kun kan godhame erga Iraaq haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) booda daangaa ishee cuftee turee dha.

title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia's Sharurah base
english: Houthi forces announced they launched drone and missile strikes against a military installation in southern Saudi Arabia. Their spokesperson stated that the operation targeted specific facilities used to oversee military actions against Yemen. Meanwhile, the group has recently expanded its territorial control along the Yemeni coastline bordering the Red Sea.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በደቡባዊ ሳውዲ አረቢያ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ በድሮን እና በረጅም ርቀት ሚሳኤሎች ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የቡድኑ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት ጥቃቱ በየመን ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችን የሚያስተባብሩ ማዕከላትን ያነጣጠረ ነው። በሌላ በኩል፣ ቡድኑ ባለፉት ጥቂት ቀናት ውስጥ በየመን የቀይ ባህር የባህር ጠረፍ አብዛኛውን ክፍል መቆጣጠሩ ታውቋል።
oromo: Humni Houthii buufata waraanaa kibba Arabaa Saawudii irratti rooketii fi dooniiwwan namoota hin feeneen haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Dubbi himaan garee kanaa akka jedhetti, haleellaan kun buufataaleen waraanaa Yeman irratti duula gaggeessan irratti xiyyeeffateera. Gama biraatiin, gareen kun guyyoota darban keessa lafa harka caalu qarqara galaana diimaa kan Yeman to'annoo isaa jala galcheera.

title: Iran’a Pezeshkian says Iran will not surrender to US pressure
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has publicly declared that Iran will not yield to American pressure. He accused the United States of attacking civilian life by restricting access to food, medicine, and essential services rather than engaging directly with the military. Pezeshkian emphasized that the Iranian people will not be intimidated and remain committed to resisting these foreign policies.
amharic: የኢራኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ ፔዘሽኪያን ኢራን ለአሜሪካ ጫና እጅ እንደማትሰጥ በይፋ አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ በወታደራዊ ግጭት ፈንታ በምግብ፣ በመድኃኒት እና በመሠረተ ልማት ላይ በማነጣጠር በሲቪል ህዝቡ ላይ ጦርነት እያወጀች ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። የኢራን ህዝብ በማስፈራራት የሚንበረከክ እንዳልሆነም አጽንኦት ሰጥተው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan, biyyi isaanii dhiibbaa Ameerikaa jala akka hin galle ifatti ibsaniiru. Ameerikaan waraana kallattiidhaan raayyaa ittisaa waliin godhuu mannaa, nyaata, qorichaafi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti duuluun lammiilee miidhaa jirti jedhaniiru. Ummanni Iraan dhiibbaa akkanaa dura dhaabbachuuf murteeffateera jedhaniiru.

title: Trump's comments on a united Ireland may have targeted audience across the Atlantic
english: During a visit to Ireland, Donald Trump unexpectedly expressed his support for a future unified Ireland, sparking widespread debate. However, political experts and former officials clarified that these comments do not reflect an official change in U.S. foreign policy. Most analysts suggest his remarks were casual statements rather than a new diplomatic strategy, as the U.S. remains firmly committed to the existing Good Friday Agreement.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአየርላንድ ባደረጉት ጉብኝት ወቅት አየርላንድ ወደፊት አንድ እንደምትሆን እንደሚጠብቁ መግለጻቸው ከፍተኛ አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። ይሁን እንጂ የፖለቲካ ተንታኞችና የቀድሞ የዩኤስ ባለስልጣናት ይህ አስተያየት የአሜሪካን የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ እንደማይቀይር አስረድተዋል። አብዛኛዎቹ ተንታኞች ንግግሩ ከባድ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ሳይሆን እንደተለመደው በድንገት የተሰጠ አስተያየት መሆኑን እና አሜሪካ አሁንም በጎድ ፍራይዴይ ስምምነት ላይ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት እንደምትቀጥል ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump yeroo biyya Ayirland daawwatanitti, gara fuulduraatti Ayirlandiin tokko ta'uu ishee arguun akka isa gammachiisu dubbachuun isaanii yaada adda addaa uumeera. Ta'us, ogeeyyiin siyaasaa fi hoggantoonni duraanii akka ibsanitti, yaanni kun jijjiirama siyaasa alaa Amerikaa kan argisiisu miti. Yaadni kun karoora diippilomaasii haaraa utuu hin taane, dubbii tasaa kan ta'e fi Amerikaan waliigaltee 'Good Friday Agreement' jedhamu irratti qabdu kan jabaatee itti fufu ta'uu ibsameera.

title: USA edge Spain to book Women’s Basketball World Cup final against France
english: The United States women's basketball team defeated Spain 76-66 in a competitive semifinal match to secure their spot in the World Cup final. The Americans, led by Breanna Stewart, pulled away in the final quarter to set up a gold-medal game against France. France advanced to the final after a dominant victory over the tournament hosts, Germany.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሴቶች የቅርጫት ኳስ ቡድን በግማሽ ፍጻሜው ስፔንን 76 ለ 66 በማሸነፍ ለዓለም ዋንጫው ፍጻሜ አልፏል። ብሬና ስቲዋርት በቡድኑ የፊት መስመር በመምራት አሜሪካ በመጨረሻው ሩብ ሰዓት የነበረውን ፉክክር በማሸነፍ ከፈረንሳይ ጋር ለዋንጫ የሚጫወቱበትን ዕድል ፈጥረዋል። ፈረንሳይ ለፍጻሜው የደረሰችው አስተናጋጇን ጀርመንን በማሸነፍ ነው።
oromo: Garee kubbaa sagaltuu dubartoota Ameerikaa tapha walakkaa xumuraa irratti Ispeen 76 fi 66 injifachuun xumura Waancaa Addunyaaf qulquloofateera. Gareen Ameerikaa qajeelfama Breanna Stewart jalatti tapha kutaa dhumaa irratti jabinaan taphachuun xumura irratti Faransaay wajjin taphachuuf dirqameera. Faransaay kan xumuraaf geesse biyya qopheessituu Jarman injifachuun ishee ni yaadatama.

title: First naval battle between drones takes place in the Black Sea
english: A historic naval engagement occurred in the Black Sea involving only unmanned surface vessels. During this encounter, a Ukrainian drone successfully destroyed a Russian naval drone. This event marks the first time that two robotic warships have battled each other at sea.
amharic: በጥቁር ባህር ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሰው አልባ የባህር ላይ መርከቦች የተሳተፉበት ወታደራዊ ግጭት ተካሂዷል። በዚህ አጋጣሚ የዩክሬን የባህር ላይ ድሮን የሩሲያን መርከብ ማጥፋት ችሏል። ይህ ድርጊት በታሪክ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ሁለት ሮቦቲክ የጦር መርከቦች በባህር ላይ ሲፋለሙ የታየበት አጋጣሚ ነው።
oromo: Garee lolaa bishaan keessatti wal-dhabaan lama kan nama hin qabne (drones) yeroo jalqabaaf gara fuulduraatti wal-loluun isaanii gabaasameera. Giddduu kana, dooniiwwan humna galaanaa Yukreen kan ta'e tookkoon, dooniiwwan humna galaanaa Raashiyaa kan ta'e tokko barbadeesseera. Kunis yeroo jalqabaatiif dooniiwwan nama hin qabne lama bishaan keessatti wal-loluu isaanii kan agarsiisu ta'a.

title: Ebola spreads to seventh DRC province as gov’t insists cases are declining
english: The Ebola virus has expanded to a seventh province in the Democratic Republic of Congo after an infected individual traveled through the region and neighboring countries. Despite this wider reach, health officials have observed indications that the overall spread of the disease is beginning to slow down. Authorities continue to monitor the situation closely while remaining cautious about the outbreak's development.
amharic: የኢቦላ ቫይረስ በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ አንድ በበሽታው የተያዘ ሰው በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች እና ጎረቤት ሀገራት መጓዙን ተከትሎ ወደ ሰባተኛው ግዛት ተዛምቷል። በሽታው ቢስፋፋም፣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች የቫይረሱ ስርጭት መቀነስ የሚያሳዩ ምልክቶች መታየታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም መንግስት በበሽታው ቁጥጥር ላይ ጥንቃቄ የተሞላበት አካሄድ በመከተል ሁኔታውን በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Vaayrasii Ibolaa namni dhukkubichi itti mul'ate tokko naannolee garagaraa fi biyyoota ollaa keessa imaluun isaa booda, RD Kongo keessatti gara kutaa biyyaa torbaffaatti babal'ateera. Babal'achuu dhukkubichaa kana hordofuun, ogeeyyiin fayyaa tamsa'inni vaayrasichaa hir'achuu akka jalqabe himaniiru. Ta'us, mootummaan hanga ammaatti of eeggannoo cimaa gochuu fi haalicha hordofuu itti fufuun barbaachisaa akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Second crypto billionaire donates record $49m to far-right Reform UK
english: Two cryptocurrency billionaires have each donated nearly $49 million to the Reform UK party, totaling $97 million in funding within just two days. While the donors claim their contributions are intended to improve British politics and level the playing field, the party is currently under police investigation regarding potential illegal foreign funding. Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch has criticized the move, arguing that financial resources cannot compensate for a lack of integrity.
amharic: ሁለት የክሪፕቶ ከረንሲ ቢሊየነሮች ለእንግሊዝ ሪፎርም ፓርቲ እያንዳንዳቸው ወደ 49 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በመለገስ በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ ብቻ 97 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ድጋፍ ሰጥተዋል። ለጋሾቹ የገንዘብ ድጋፉን ያደረጉት የሀገሪቱን ፖለቲካ ለማሻሻል እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ ፓርቲው ግን ህገ-ወጥ የውጭ ሀገር የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ተቀብሏል በሚል በፖሊስ ምርመራ እየተደረገበት ይገኛል። የኮንሰርቫቲቭ ፓርቲ መሪ ኬሚ ባዴኖክ በበኩላቸው፣ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ አቅም ቢኖርም የፓርቲውን እውነተኛ የሥነ-ምግባር ጉድለት መሸፈን እንደማይቻል በመግለጽ ትችታቸውን ሰንዝረዋል።
oromo: Biliyeenaroonni kiriptoo-kaarentii lama ta’an paartii ‘Reform UK’ jedhamuuf tokkoon tokkoon isaanii qarshii miliyoona 49 ol kanneen kennan yoo ta’u, guyyoota lama keessatti walumaagalatti miliyoona 97 arjoomaniiru. Arjoomonni kun tarkaanfii fudhatan kanas siyaasa biyyattii fooyyessuuf kan jedhan yoo ta’u, paartiin kun garuu gargaarsa alaa seeraan alaa ta’e fudhateera jedhamee qorannoo poolisii jalatti argama. Hogganaan paartii Konservativii Kemi Badenoch gama isaaniin, maallaqni gurguddaan kun amanamummaa fi qulqullina siyaasaa bakka bu’uu akka hin dandeenye ibsuun mormii isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Fire at nursing home in Chile kills 16 elderly residents
english: A tragic fire at a nursing home in Pitrufquen, Chile, resulted in the deaths of 16 elderly residents. Emergency crews rescued ten survivors, who were subsequently hospitalized for treatment. Authorities noted that the private facility had been under scrutiny for years due to recurring safety and regulatory violations.
amharic: በቺሊ ፒትሩፍኩዌን ከተማ በሚገኝ የአረጋውያን ማረፊያ ቤት በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ 16 አረጋውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች አስር ሰዎችን ከሞት ታድገው ወደ ህክምና ተቋማት ልከዋል። ማረፊያው ከዚህ ቀደም ለበርካታ ዓመታት የደህንነት እና የህግ ደንቦችን በመጣስ ተደጋጋሚ ቅጣት እንደተጣለበት ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Pitrufquyen kan biyya Chiilii keessatti bakka maanguddootni itti tursiifaman tokkotti balaa ibiddaa gaheen lubbuun namoota 16 darbeera. Hojjettootni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa namoota 10 balaa sana keessaa baasanii gara hospitaalaatti erguun isaan gargaaraniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa akka ibsanitti, dhaabbatichi kun waggoota hedduuf seeraa fi qajeelfama tasgabbii eeguu dhabuun isaa fi kanaan dura irra deddeebi'amee adabbiin irratti dabarsamaa turuun isaa beekameera.

title: Israeli air strike kills Palestinian in southern Gaza
english: A Palestinian individual has passed away following an Israeli aerial attack on vehicles located in Khan Younis, southern Gaza. Reports from local media indicate that several other people, including children, also suffered injuries during this military operation. Medical officials at Nasser Hospital confirmed the fatality.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ህይወቱ አልፏል። በዚሁ ጥቃት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው የዜና ምንጮች ዘግበዋል። የናስር ሆስፒታል የህክምና ባለሙያዎች ጉዳት የደረሰበት ግለሰብ መሞቱን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Magaala Kaani Yuunis kan kibba Gaazaatti haleellaa xiyyaaraan Israa'el iddoo konkolaataalee irratti gaggeessiteen namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbeera. Gabaasoonni akka ibsanitti, haleellaa kanaan ijoollee dabalatee namoonni biroo hedduun miidhamaniiru. Hospitaalli Naasir akka mirkaneessetti, namni miidhame kun yeroo booda du'eera.

title: Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of launching 129 strikes in 48 hours
english: A Houthi spokesperson has claimed that Saudi Arabian fighter jets carried out 129 airstrikes across several Yemeni provinces over a two-day period. These military operations involved advanced aircraft departing from Saudi airbases to hit various civilian and strategic areas. In response, the Houthi leadership has promised to retaliate against these actions.
amharic: የሁቲዎች ቃል አቀባይ የሳውዲ አረቢያ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በሁለት ቀናት ውስጥ በየመን በተለያዩ ግዛቶች ላይ 129 የአየር ጥቃቶችን መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የተፈጸሙት ከሳውዲ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች በተነሱ ዘመናዊ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ቡድኑ ለደረሰው ጥቃት ምላሽ እንደሚሰጥ ዛቻ አዘል መልእክት አስተላልፏል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan garee Hutiin, xiyyaarotni waraana Sa’udii Arabaa guyyoota lama keessatti aanolee Yemen garaagaraa irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa 129 raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun xiyyaara waraanaa ammayyaa buufataalee waraana Sa’udii irraa ka’aniin kan raawwatame ta’uu ibsameera. Gareen kunis haleellaa kanaaf deebii akka kennan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Trump says Houthis asked US not to intervene in Yemen
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that Houthi representatives reached out to the United States to request non-interference in their ongoing conflict with Saudi Arabia. He noted that the group expressed a desire to avoid direct military confrontation with the U.S. and is currently permitting most maritime traffic to pass safely. Trump further indicated his intention to address the Houthis' grievances with specific nations to help resolve the situation.
amharic: የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ከሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ ጋር ባላቸው ግጭት አሜሪካ ጣልቃ እንዳትገባ ጥያቄ ማቅረባቸውን ገልጸዋል። ቡድኑ ከአሜሪካ ጋር በቀጥታ ግጭት ውስጥ መግባት እንደማይፈልግ መግለጻቸውንና አብዛኛው የባህር ትራፊክ በሰላም እንዲያልፍ እየፈቀዱ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል። ትራምፕ ችግሩን ለመፍታትና የሁቲዎችን ቅሬታ ለመፍታት እንደሚሰሩም አመላክተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantichi duraanii Donald Traamp akka jedhanitti, gareen Huutii waraana Saudii Arabiyaa wajjin godhachaa jiran keessa Ameerikaan akka hin galle gaafataniiru. Gareen kun Ameerikaa wajjin walitti bu'u akka hin barbaanne ibsuun, dooniiwwan hedduunis nagaadhaan akka darban hayyamaniiru. Traamp dhimmi kun akka furamuuf komii gareen Huutii biyyoota tokko tokko irratti qaban furuuf akka hojjetan dubbataniiru.

title: Fire at nursing home in Chile kills 16 residents
english: A tragic fire at the El Edén nursing home in southern Chile resulted in the deaths of 16 elderly residents. While ten people were safely evacuated, the cause of the late-night blaze remains under investigation. In response to the disaster, the Chilean president has ordered a nationwide review of safety standards at nursing facilities to prevent similar future tragedies.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ቺሊ በሚገኝ ኤል ኤደን በተባለ የጡረተኞች መጦሪያ ጣቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ 16 አረጋውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አስር ሰዎች በህይወት ቢተርፉም፣ የእሳቱ መንስኤ እስካሁን አልታወቀም። የቺሊ ፕሬዝዳንት ተመሳሳይ አሳዛኝ ሁኔታ እንዳይደገም በመላ ሀገሪቱ የሚገኙ የመጦሪያ ጣቢያዎችን የደህንነት ሁኔታ በድጋሚ እንዲመረመር ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Masaraa ga’eessota ykn maanguddoota 'El Edén' jedhamu kan kibba biyya Chilee keessatti argamu irratti ibiddii tasa ka'een maanguddoonni 16 lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Namoonni kudhan balaa kana jalaa kan ba’an yoo ta’u, sababni ibiddichaa hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane. Prezidaantiin biyyattii balaa kana booda, gadda guddaa ibsuun, namoonni kan biroo akka hin miidhamneef fooyya’iinsa nageenyaa manneen maanguddootaa hunda irratti akka godhamu ajajanii jiru.

title: Israel bombs southern Lebanon as talks postponed
english: Negotiations between Israel and Lebanon, facilitated by the United States, have been delayed until October. These discussions, originally planned for this month in Rome, are currently on hold. Meanwhile, the conflict continues as Israeli forces maintain military strikes across southern Lebanon.
amharic: በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት በእስራኤል እና በሊባኖስ መካከል ይካሄድ የነበረው የድርድር ሂደት እስከ ጥቅምት ወር ድረስ ተራዝሟል። በሮም ይካሄዳል ተብሎ ይጠበቅ የነበረው ይህ ውይይት ለጊዜው ታግዷል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ላይ ጥቃታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Mariin gidduu galeessa Ameerikaan Israa'elii fi Libanoos gidduutti gaggeeffamaa ture gara ji'a Onkololeessaatti dabarfameera. Mariin kun kanaan dura ji'a kana magaalaa Roomaatti akka gaggeeffamu karoorfamee ture. Yeroo ammaa kanatti Israa'el kibba Libanoosirratti weerara ishee kan itti fuftee jirtu yommuu ta'u, mariin kunis yeroof addaan citeera.

title: Gaza genocide documentary ‘NAZA’ wins Special Jury Prize at Venice
english: The documentary film 'NAZA', which focuses on the mass killing of Palestinians in Gaza, has been awarded the Special Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival. During the event, co-director Yuval Abraham stated that the violence was intentional rather than accidental, citing accounts from Israeli intelligence sources. He also criticized Western nations for their role in supporting these actions.
amharic: በጋዛ ስለተፈጸመው የፍልስጤማውያን ጭፍጨፋ የሚያትተው 'ናዛ' የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም በቬኒስ የፊልም ፌስቲቫል የልዩ ዳኞች ሽልማትን አሸንፏል። የፊልሙ ተባባሪ ዳይሬክተር ዩቫል አብርሃም እንደገለጹት፣ በጋዛ የተፈጸመው ድርጊት በአጋጣሚ ሳይሆን ታቅዶ የተፈጸመ መሆኑን ከእስራኤል የደህንነት መኮንኖች እንደሰሙ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም ምዕራባውያን አገራት ለዚህ ጥቃት ድጋፍ በመስጠት ተባባሪ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ወቀሳቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Fiilmiin 'NAZA' jedhamu kan waa'ee dhumaatii Falasxiinotaa Gaazaa keessatti raawwatamee ibsu, ayyaana fiilmii Veeniis irratti badhaasa addaa fudhateera. Qindeessaan fiilmichaa Yuval Abrahaam akka ibsetti, ajjeechaan kun tasa kan uumame osoo hin taane karoorfamee kan raawwatame ta'uu fiila'oolee odeeffannoo Israa'el irraa dhageenyee jedheera. Kana malees, biyyoonni lixaa gocha kana deeggaruudhaan itti gaafatamummaa qabu jechuun komateera.

title: US court blocks Trump administration plan to cut disaster agency workforce
english: A US federal judge has blocked the Trump administration's attempt to reduce the workforce at FEMA, the agency responsible for responding to national disasters. The judge ruled that the Department of Homeland Security exceeded its legal authority by trying to significantly cut the number of emergency reservists without providing a valid justification. This decision protects the agency's operational independence, which is legally mandated to ensure effective disaster response across the country.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የተፈጥሮ አደጋዎችን የሚቆጣጠረውን የፌማ (FEMA) ተቋም የሰው ኃይል ለመቀነስ ያቀደውን ዕቅድ አግደዋል። ዳኛዋ የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት መሥሪያ ቤት ተገቢውን ምክንያት ሳያቀርብ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሠራተኞችን ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ለመቀነስ መሞከሩ ከሕግ ውጭ ነው ብለዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ተቋሙ አገራዊ አደጋዎችን ለመከላከል ያለውን ነጻነትና አቅም ለማስጠበቅ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa kan Ameerikaa, mootummaan Trump dhaabbata balaa uumamaa FEMA jedhamu irratti hojjettoota hirisuuf baasee ture akka dhaabatu murteesseera. Abbaan seerichaa, Ministeerri Nageenya Biyoolessaa sababa gahaa malee hojjettoota ariifachiisaa hirisuun aangoo isaa akka darbe ibseera. Murteen kun dhaabbatichi balaa uumamaa ittisuuf gahee isaa akka bahuuf bilisummaa isaa eeguuf gargaara.

title: Bahrain says it will not participate in Iran’s proposed Hormuz meeting
english: Bahrain has officially declined an invitation to join a regional meeting in Oman regarding the future of the Strait of Hormuz, which is currently blockaded by Iran. The Bahraini government stated that it will not engage in such discussions with Tehran until formal diplomatic relations are restored between the two nations. Furthermore, Bahrain criticized Iran's approach, arguing that regional security cannot be achieved through policies of appeasement while the waterway remains restricted.
amharic: ባህሬን በኢራን ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የወደፊት ሁኔታ ላይ ለመወያየት በኦማን እንዲካሄድ የታቀደውን ስብሰባ እንደማትሳተፍ አስታውቃለች። የባህሬን መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እስካልተመለሰ ድረስ ከሀገሪቱ ጋር በማንኛውም የጋራ ስብሰባ ላይ እንደማትገኝ ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም ሀገሪቱ የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ መተማመኛን ሳይሆን የባህር መስመሩ ያለ ምንም ቅድመ ሁኔታ ለሁሉም ክፍት መሆን እንዳለበት አሳስባለች።
oromo: Bahrain walgahii biyyoota naannichaa kan Omaanitti qophaa'e fi gara fuulduraa daandii galaana Hormuz irratti mari'achuuf karoorfame irratti akka hirmaattu affeeramtes diddeetti. Mootummaan Bahraini akka ibsetti, hariiroon dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti haaraa erga hin deebi'in, marii Iran waliin ta'u irratti hirmaachuuf fedhii hin qabu. Gama biraatiin, Bahrain nageenyi naannichaa kan mirkanaa'u siyaasa jaalalaan osoo hin taane, daandiin galaana sun dhiibbaa fi kaffaltii tokko malee bilisa ta'uu qaba jettee amanti.

title: Will Houthi advances in Yemen give Iran leverage in its war with the US?
english: The Houthi movement has expanded its control over Yemen’s Red Sea coastline, specifically near the vital Bab al-Mandeb strait. This strategic advancement threatens global oil supplies and places new pressure on Saudi Arabia, raising concerns about a potential escalation in the conflict between the United States and Iran. Analysts are now questioning whether this development provides Tehran with increased influence and a stronger position in its ongoing regional tensions with Washington.
amharic: የሁቲ አማጽያን በየመን ቀይ ባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢ እና በባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር መስመር ላይ ቁጥጥራቸውን በማጠናከራቸው ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። ይህ ስልታዊ እንቅስቃሴ ለነዳጅ አቅርቦት ስጋት በመፍጠር በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና እያሳደረ ሲሆን፣ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ግጭት የበለጠ ሊያባብሰው ይችላል ተብሎ ተሰግቷል። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ ይህ ድርጊት ለኢራን በአሜሪካ ላይ ያላትን የድርድር አቅም እና ተጽዕኖ ከፍ ሊያደርግ ይችላል ወይ የሚለው ጥያቄ ተነስቷል።
oromo: Humni Houtii qarqara galaana diimaa Yaman to’achuu isaa fi bakka tarsiimawaa kan ta’e Bab al-Mandeb irratti injifannoo argachuun isaa sodaa guddaa uumeera. Tarkaanfiin kun dhiyeessii boba’aa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa kan uumuufi biyya Sa’udii Arabiyaa rakkoo keessa kan galche ta’us, walitti bu’iinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru daran hammaachisuu danda’a. Kanaan walqabatee, guddinni kun Iraan humna Ameerikaa wajjin jiru irratti dhiibbaa caalu akka gootuufi bakka injifannoo irra akka geessu ishee gargaaruu danda’a jechuun qorattoonni gaaffii keessa galchaa jiru.

title: Yemen government forces say hit Houthis in Red Sea city
english: Yemeni government forces recently launched military strikes against Houthi fighters in the port city of Mocha. This conflict has intensified as the Houthis successfully seized control of the remaining Red Sea coastline and critical islands in the area. Consequently, these military operations have triggered a significant increase in the number of civilians being displaced from their homes.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በሞቻ ወደብ ከተማ በሚገኙ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሁቲ ቡድን የቀረውን የየመን ቀይ ባህር ጠረፍ እና ስልታዊ ደሴቶችን በመቆጣጠሩ ግጭቱ ተባብሷል። በዚህ ውጊያ ምክንያት ከየቤታቸው የሚፈናቀሉ ሲቪሎች ቁጥርም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman magaalaa buufata doonii Mochaa keessatti loltoota Huutii irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gareen Huutii qarqara galaana diimaa Yaman keessatti hafe fi bakkoota tarsiimawaa ta'an to'annaa isaanii jala waan galchaniif waraanni kun daran hammaateera. Walitti bu'iinsa kanaan walqabatee namoonni nagaa qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'anii godaanan baay'inaan dabaleera.

title: Trump says Houthis asked US not to intervene in Yemen
english: President Donald Trump claims the Houthi group in Yemen contacted the U.S. to request that Washington avoid interfering in their conflict with Saudi Arabia. Despite Saudi pressure to launch military strikes following Houthi advances near critical shipping lanes, Trump has so far refused to intervene. Meanwhile, the region remains tense as drone attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure continue to threaten energy supplies.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ የየመኑ ሁቲ አማፂያን ከአሜሪካ ጋር እንዳይጋጩና አሜሪካ በየመን ግጭት ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንዳትገባ ጥያቄ ማቅረባቸውን ተናግረዋል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መስመሮች ላይ ቁጥጥር እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ትራምፕ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ያቀረበችውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የመውሰድ ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ በሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመሮች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ የድሮን ጥቃቶች በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ስጋት ከፍ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, gareen Huutii kan Yaman keessa jiru tokkummaan isaanii fi biyyi Sa'udii akka walitti hin bu'ineef Ameerikaan gidduu akka hin galle gaafateera. Huutiin daandiiwwan markabaa irratti to'annoo babal'ifachaa jiraatus, Tiraamp mootummaan Sa'udii lola akka irratti banuuf dhiheesseef diddeera. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, miidhaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa boba'aa Sa'udii irratti raawwatamaa jiru naannichatti yaaddoo nageenyaa fi gatii boba'aa dabalee jira.

title: Saudi civil defence says two wounded by Houthi projectile
english: Two people were injured after a projectile fired by Houthi rebels struck a border region in southern Saudi Arabia. The attack caused property damage to local vehicles, buildings, and a mosque. Saudi authorities had issued warnings about potential strikes shortly before the incident occurred.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ ደቡባዊ ድንበር ላይ በሁቲ አማጽያን በተተኮሰ ሚሳይል ሁለት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጥቃቱ በአካባቢው በሚገኙ መኪኖች፣ ህንጻዎች እና መስጊድ ላይ የቁሳቁስ ውድመት አስከትሏል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ ጥቂት ሰዓታት ቀደም ብሎ ሊከሰቱ ስለሚችሉ አደጋዎች ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተው ነበር።
oromo: Houthi warra finxaaleyyii ta'aniin meeshaan waraanaa gara daangaa kibba Saudii Arabiyaatti dhukaafame namoota lama irratti miidhaa geessiseera. Miidhaan kun konkolaattota, mana amantaa fi gamoo garaa garaa irratti miidhaa qabeenyaa dhaqqabsiiseera. Aangeyyoonni Saudii miidhaan kun osoo hin raawwatamin sa'aatii muraasa dura akeekkachiisa kennanii turan.

title: Explosions heard off coast of Qeshm in southern Iran, report says
english: State media in Iran reported that two loud explosions were heard near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday. This incident occurs amid heightened tensions in the region, characterized by an ongoing series of retaliatory strikes between Iranian forces and the United States. These military hostilities have frequently impacted oil tankers and strategic maritime routes in the Gulf.
amharic: የኢራን የመንግስት ሚዲያ በቅሽም ደሴት አቅራቢያ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ ሁለት ኃይለኛ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ ዘግቧል። ይህ ክስተት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው የውጥረት ሁኔታ እየተባባሰ በሄደበት ወቅት የተፈጠረ ነው። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦችን እና በክልሉ የሚገኙ ስትራቴጂካዊ የባህር መስመሮችን ለከፍተኛ ስጋት ዳርጓል።
oromo: Miidiyaan mootummaa Iraan akka gabaasetti, guyyaa Sanbataa naannoo jireenyaa Qeshm kan gubbaa galaana Hormuzitti dhukaatiin guddaan lama dhaga'ameera. Taateen kun kan uumame yeroo waraanni fi wal-dhabiinsi gidduu Iraanii fi Ameerikaa jidduu jiru daran hammaachaa jiru keessaatti. Wal-dhabiinsi kun dooniiwwan boba'aa fe'an fi daandiiwwan galaanaatti fayyadamtoota ta'an irratti miidhaa geessisaa jira.

title: Selling the war: Purges, polygraphs and propaganda
english: The Trump administration is struggling to maintain a positive narrative regarding the ongoing conflict with Iran as the US midterm elections approach. Factors such as rising living costs, aggressive social media communications, and strained relations between the Pentagon and the press have made it difficult to sway public opinion. These challenges highlight the administration's increasing difficulty in managing its wartime messaging effectively.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ እየቀረበ ባለበት ወቅት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከኢራን ጋር ስላለው ግጭት አዎንታዊ ገጽታ ለመፍጠር እየተቸገረ ነው። የኑሮ ውድነት መጨመር፣ የፕሬዚዳንቱ ቀስቃሽ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መልእክቶች እና በመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር እና በጋዜጠኞች መካከል ያለው ውጥረት መንግሥት ለህዝብ የሚሰጠውን መልእክት ተቀባይነት እንዳያገኝ አድርገውታል። እነዚህ ተግዳሮቶች አስተዳደሩ በጦርነት ጊዜ የሚከተለውን የፕሮፓጋንዳ ስራ ለማስተዳደር ምን ያህል እየተቸገረ እንዳለ ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Filannoon giddu-galeessa Ameerikaa dhiyaachaa waan jiruuf, bulchiinsi Trump walitti bu'iinsa Iran waliin jiru irratti miira gaarii uumuuf rakkachaa jira. Gatiin boba'aa fi nyaataa dabaluun, ergaawwan miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti maxxanfaman kanneen mufachiisoo ta'anii fi hariiroon Pentagoonii fi miidiyaalee gidduu jiru hojiin mootummaan ergaa isaa uummata biraan gahuuf yaalu akka hin milkoofne taasiseera. Rakkoon kun bulchiinsi Trump yeroo waraanaatti mala odeeffannoo isaa to'achuuf dhiibbaa cimaa keessa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: India vs Sri Lanka: Women’s T20 Asia Cup 2026 final – schedule, teams, form
english: India and Sri Lanka are set to compete in the Women’s T20 Asia Cup final this Sunday at the Dubai International Stadium. India enters the match looking for their eighth tournament title, while the defending champions, Sri Lanka, hope to repeat their victory from two years ago. Both teams have performed strongly throughout the event and are prepared for this highly anticipated championship decider.
amharic: የህንድ እና የሲሪላንካ የሴቶች የቲ-20 የእስያ ዋንጫ የፍጻሜ ጨዋታ እሁድ በዱባይ ዓለም አቀፍ ስታዲየም ይካሄዳል። ህንድ ስምንተኛውን የውድድሩን ዋንጫ ለማንሳት ስትዘጋጅ፣ ባለፈው ውድድር አሸናፊ የነበሩት ሲሪላንካዎች ደግሞ ድላቸውን ለመድገም ይሞክራሉ። ሁለቱም ቡድኖች በውድድሩ ጥሩ ብቃት በማሳየት ለፍጻሜው ጨዋታ ዝግጅታቸውን አጠናቀዋል።
oromo: Taphi xumuraa waancaa T20 Eshiyaa kan dubartoota gidduu Itiyoophiyaa fi Siiriilaankaa gidduutti Dilbata dhufu kan gaggeeffamu ta'a. Indiyaan waancaa kana yeroo saddeettaffaaf injifachuuf kan karfeessitu yoo ta'u, Siiriilaankaan immoo qophee darbe injifatte san deebitee mirkaneeffachuuf carraaqqii gooti. Gareewwan lamaanuu yeroo hunda taphichatti gaarii waan turaniif, taphichi guddinaan kan eeggamu ta'a.

title: Man arrested over killing of Tasia Fortune, found hanging from tree
english: Authorities in Mississippi have taken Jarques Ratliff into custody regarding the death of Tasia Fortune. The victim, a Black woman, was discovered hanging from a tree last month. Although initially unclear, officials eventually classified her death as a homicide, prompting calls from lawmakers for a federal investigation into the incident.
amharic: በሚሲሲፒ ግዛት ፖሊስ ታሲያ ፎርቹን የተባለችውን ሴት በመግደል ወንጀል ጃርክስ ራትሊፍ የተባለ ግለሰብን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። የሟች አስከሬን ባለፈው ወር በዛፍ ላይ ተንጠልጥሎ የተገኘ ሲሆን፣ ምርመራው ግድያ መሆኑን ካረጋገጠ በኋላ ጉዳዩ በፌዴራል ደረጃ እንዲጣራ የህግ አውጪዎች ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin naannoo Mississippi namicha Jarques Ratliff jedhamu, ajjeechaa dubartii Tasia Fortune jedhamtuun walqabatee qabuu isaa beeksiseera. Reeffi dubartittii ji'a darbe muka irratti fannifamee kan argame yoo ta'u, qorannoon booda ajjeechaa ta'uun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Kanaan walqabatee, qaamoleen seera baastuun dhimmi kun gadi fageenyaan akka qoratamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Couple welcomes child from embryo frozen for 22 years
english: A Greek couple recently celebrated the birth of a baby from an embryo that had been frozen for 22 years. The successful IVF procedure occurred in Athens as the mother neared the government-mandated age limit of 54 for such treatments. This event marks a significant medical achievement regarding the long-term preservation of embryos.
amharic: አንድ የግሪክ ባልና ሚስት ለ22 ዓመታት በበረዶ ተከማችቶ የቆየ ፅንስ በመጠቀም ልጅ መውለዳቸውን አብስረዋል። አቴንስ ውስጥ የተወለደው ህጻን፣ እናትየው በሕግ ከተቀመጠው የ54 ዓመት የዕድሜ ጣሪያ ላይ ከመድረሷ በፊት በተደረገ የፅንስ ማስተላለፍ ሂደት የተገኘ ነው። ይህ ክስተት የፅንስ ረጅም ጊዜ የመቆየት አቅምን የሚያሳይ አስደናቂ የሕክምና ውጤት ሆኗል።
oromo: Hiriyoonni gaa'elaa gariig tokko, embriyoon waggoota 22f cabbii keessatti kuufamee ture fayyadamuudhaan mucaa godhataniiru. Mucichi magaalaa Atenasitti kan dhalate yoo ta'u, kunis haati sun umrii seeraan IVFf hayyamame kan waggaa 54 gahuuf yeroo gabaabaa hafee jirutti kan raawwatameedha. Taateen kun carraaqqii saayinsii fayyaa keessatti embriyoowwan yeroo dheeraaf qulqullina isaanii eeggachuu danda'an ilaalchisee milkaa'ina guddaa agarsiisa.

title: US Open women’s singles final live: Aryna Sabalenka vs Elena Rybakina
english: Aryna Sabalenka is set to face Elena Rybakina in the highly anticipated US Open women’s singles final. The championship match is scheduled to take place at Arthur Ashe Stadium in New York. Fans can follow live updates, statistical analysis, and expert commentary as Sabalenka attempts to defend her title.
amharic: አሪና ሳባሌንካ በዩኤስ ኦፕን የሴቶች የነጠላ ፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ከኤሌና ሪባኪና ጋር ይፋለማሉ። የሻምፒዮናው ጨዋታ በኒው ዮርክ በሚገኘው አርተር አሽ ስታዲየም የሚካሄድ ይሆናል። አድናቂዎች ሳባሌንካ ዋንጫዋን ለመከላከል በምታደርገው ጥረት የቀጥታ መረጃዎችን፣ የስታቲስቲክስ ትንታኔዎችን እና የባለሙያዎችን አስተያየት መከታተል ይችላሉ።
oromo: Aryna Sabalenka fi Elena Rybakina tapha xumuraa korguu dubartoota US Open irratti wal morkachuuf qophaa’aniiru. Taphi injifannoo kun magaala New Yorkitti bakka Arthur Ashe Stadium jedhamutti kan gaggeeffamu ta'a. Sabalenka mata duree ishee itti fufuuf qophii ishee taasiftuun walqabatee, hordoftoonni odeeffannoo yeroo gabaabaa, xiinxala stats fi yaada ogeessotaa hordofuu danda’u.

title: Israel uses Lebanese civilians as bargaining chips
english: Israeli military forces recently entered the southern Lebanese village of Halta and detained three local residents from their homes. Among those taken was a municipal council member named Hatem Abdel-Aal, who was eventually released late that night under strict orders to report back on foot. Witnesses suggest these actions indicate that Israeli troops are using local civilians as leverage during the ongoing border conflict.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የሃልታ መንደር በመግባት ሶስት ነዋሪዎችን ከቤታቸው አፍነው ወስደዋል። ከተያዙት መካከል የከተማው ምክር ቤት አባል የሆኑት ሀተም አብደል-አል ይገኙበታል፤ እነርሱም በለሊት ቢለቀቁም እንደገና በእግር እንዲመጡ ትእዛዝ ተሰጥቷቸዋል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንደገለጹት፣ እስራኤል እነዚህን ሲቪሎች በድንበር ግጭቱ ወቅት እንደ መደራደሪያ እየተጠቀመችባቸው ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Halta jedhamtu kan kibba Libaanoositti argamtu seenuun jiraattota sadii manneen isaanii keessaa qabanii fudhataniiru. Namoota qabaman kana keessaa miseensi mana maree magaalaa Hatem Abdel-Aal kan argamu yoo ta'u, halkan keessa gadi lakkifamus miilaan akka deebi'anii gabaasaniif ajajamaniiru. Ragaan akka mul'isutti, gochi kun Israa'el lolli daangaa irratti geggeeffamaa jiruuf jireenya lammiilee kana akka meeshaa dhimma itti baatuu fi mallattoo dhiibbaa itti gochuutti fayyadamaa akka jirtu agarsiisa.

title: Houthis say liberated more than 200 prisoners in newly captured regions
english: The Houthi group in Yemen announced the release of over 200 of their fighters who were held captive by Saudi-backed forces. These individuals were freed after the Houthis launched a significant military offensive to seize new territories near the Bab al-Mandab Strait. Some of these released prisoners had been in detention for as long as eight years.
amharic: የየመኑ የሁቲ ቡድን በሳዑዲ በሚደገፉ ኃይሎች ታስረው የነበሩ ከ200 በላይ ታጣቂዎቹን መፍታታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ታጣቂዎቹ ነፃ የወጡት የሁቲ ቡድን በባብ አል-ማንዳብ ስትሬት አቅራቢያ በሚገኙ አካባቢዎች ባደረገው ፈጣን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ነው። ከተለቀቁት መካከል አንዳንዶቹ እስከ ስምንት ዓመት ድረስ በእስር ላይ እንደነበሩ ተገልጿል።
oromo: gareen Huutii Yaman keessatti argamu, loltoota isaa 200 ol ta'an kanneen humnoota Sa'udii deggarramaniin qabamanii turan gadhifamuu isaanii beeksiseera. Loltoonni kun kan gadhifaman gareen kun naannoo Bab al-Mandab jedhamutti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhateen lafa haarawa to'annoo isaa jala oolchuu isaatiin booda. Loltoota gadhifaman kana keessaa muraasni isaanii hanga waggaa saddeetiif hidhaa keessa turaniiru.

title: Iran-Oman understanding does not provide for immediate reopening of Strait of Hormuz, Tasnim reports
english: A recent agreement between Iran and Oman sets a foundation for the potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, though it will not happen right away. Iranian officials indicated that this move aims to solidify their control over the waterway. Ultimately, any decision to open the strait remains contingent upon the United States agreeing to specific terms set by Tehran.
amharic: በኢራን እና በኦማን መካከል የተደረሰው ስምምነት የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን ወዲያውኑ ለመክፈት የሚያስችል አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ለወደፊት ለመክፈት መሰረት ይጥላል። የኢራን ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ይህ እርምጃ ሀገሪቱ በባህር ሰላጤው ላይ ያላትን ሉዓላዊነት ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው። የባህር በሩ ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚከፈተው አሜሪካ የኢራንን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ስትቀበል ብቻ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: waliigalteen Iran fi Oman gidduutti godhame karaa Hormuz battalaan banuuf kan hin gargaarre ta'us, gara fuulduraatti banamuuf bu'ura kan ta'u dha. Maddoonni Iran akka ibsanitti, tarkiinni kun irratti aangoo guutuu qabaachuu isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf kan karoorfame dha. Haata'u malee, karichi akka banamuuf haala murteessaa ta'e irratti, kutaan kun kan hundaa'u Ameerikaan gaaffilee Iran fudhattee yoo raawwatte qofa dha.

title: UK expresses ‘solidarity’ with Saudi Arabia over Houthi attacks
english: The British government recently voiced its support for Saudi Arabia following ongoing Houthi attacks from Yemen. During a discussion between top officials, Britain acknowledged Saudi Arabia's right to protect its borders and resources in accordance with international rules. Both nations also committed to working together to safeguard maritime trade routes and ensure global supply chains remain secure.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት በየመን ሁቲዎች ለሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ሳውዲ አረቢያን እንደሚደግፍ ገልጿል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማቶች መካከል በተደረገ ውይይት፣ ብሪታንያ ሳውዲ አረቢያ በአለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት ራሷን የመከላከል መብት እንዳላት አረጋግጣለች። በተጨማሪም ሀገራቱ የባህር ላይ ንግድን ለመጠበቅ እና ዓለም አቀፍ የዕቃ አቅርቦት ሰንሰለት እንዳይስተጓጎል በጋራ ለመስራት ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritish ergaa deggersaa Saudii Arabiyaaf ergeera, kunis haleellaa garee Huutii kan Yemen irraa geggeeffamu hordofuudhaani. Marii ministirootaa gaggeeffameen, Biritish Saudiin seera addunyaatiin of ittisuuf mirga qabaachuu ishee beekamtii kenniteetti. Akkasumas, lameen isaanii karaa bishaan irraa akka eegamuufi dhiyeessiin meeshaalee addunyaa walirraa hin cinneef waliin hojjechuuf walii galaniiru.

title: At least 76,000 have fled fighting in Yemen since July, UN says
english: The United Nations reports that at least 76,000 people have been forced to leave their homes in Yemen since July due to ongoing conflict. This displacement figure has quadrupled in just the last week as clashes between government troops and Houthi rebels have intensified. International agencies are expressing urgent concern over the rapidly deteriorating humanitarian situation in the region.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው ከሐምሌ ወር ጀምሮ በየመን እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት ሳቢያ ቢያንስ 76,000 ሰዎች ከመኖሪያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል። በመንግስት ኃይሎች እና በሁቲ አማፂያን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሶ በመቀጠሉ፣ የተፈናቃዮች ቁጥር ባለፈው ሳምንት ብቻ በአራት እጥፍ ጨምሯል። ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት በየመን እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የሰብአዊ ቀውስ አስመልክቶ ከፍተኛ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, ji'a Adooleessaa irraa eegalee lola Yemen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun namoonni gara 76,000 ta'an qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Waraanni humnoota mootummaa fi warra Houthi gidduutti cimuun isaa, lakkoofsi namoota buqqa'anii torbee darbe qofa keessatti akka dachaa afuriin dabalu godheera. Dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa rakkoo namoomaa Yemen keessatti hammaataa jiru kanaaf yaaddoo cimaa qabu.

title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
english: Dario Amodei, the CEO of the AI company Anthropic, has urged the technology industry to slow down the rapid development of artificial intelligence. He argues that while AI offers many benefits, the serious risks it poses require stricter independent monitoring and global regulation. His proposal aims to ensure safety is prioritized before machines become too powerful or difficult to control.
amharic: የአንትሮፒክ ኩባንያ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ዳሪዮ አሞዴይ፣ የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የቴክኖሎጂ እድገት በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት እየገሰገሰ በመሆኑ እንዲቀንስ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ምንም እንኳን ቴክኖሎጂው ብዙ ጥቅሞች ቢኖሩትም፣ ሊያስከትል የሚችለው አደገኛ ሁኔታዎች ስላሉ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እና አለም አቀፍ ደንቦችን ማውጣት እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልጸዋል። አላማውም ቴክኖሎጂው ከቁጥጥር ውጪ ከመሆኑ በፊት የደህንነት ጉዳዮችን ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጥ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Anthropic, Dario Amodei, saffisni guddina teknooloojii 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) akka hir'atu gaafateera. AI faayidaa hedduu qabaatus, balaa inni fiduu danda'u ittisuuf hordoffii cimaa fi seera addunyaalessaa barbaachisaa ta'uu ibseera. Kaayyoon isaa teknooloojiin kun hamma isaa darbee to'annoo ala ta'uun isaa dura, dhimmi nageenyaa xiyyeeffannoo argachuu akka qabu dha.

title: French officials investigate if malicious act caused train derailment
english: French authorities are investigating a train derailment in Normandy that injured 44 people, including one person who was critically hurt. Investigators suspect the crash may have been caused by a piece of metal intentionally placed on the tracks. Officials have recovered the train's data recorder and are conducting interviews to determine if the incident was a deliberate act of sabotage.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል የተከሰተውን የባቡር መገፍትር አደጋ የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እያደረጉበት ነው። በአደጋው 44 ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ አንዲት ወጣት በከባድ ሁኔታ ሆስፒታል ገብታ ነበር። ተመራማሪዎች በባቡር ሀዲድ ላይ ሆን ተብሎ የተቀመጠ የብረት ቁራጭ ለአደጋው ምክንያት ሊሆን እንደሚችል በመጠርጠር፣ ድርጊቱ ሆን ተብሎ የተፈፀመ የጥፋት ተግባር መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ምርመራቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Hojjettooni mootummaa Faransaay balaa baaburaa kaaba biyyattitti mudate irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru. Balaa kanaan namoonni 44 miidhaniiru, isaan keessaas dubartittiin tokko miidhaan cimaan irra gahee ture. Qorattoonni balaan kun kan uumame gartuu sibiilaa karaa baaburaa irratti hirameera ta'uu isaatiin akka ta'e shakku, kunis gocha hammeenyaa ykn sabootaajii ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuuf qorannoon eegalameera.

title: US court rejects Trump’s emergency order keeping Michigan coal plant open
english: A federal appeals court has ruled that the U.S. Energy Department overstepped its legal authority by forcing a Michigan coal plant to stay open past its planned retirement date. The court decided there was no legitimate emergency to justify keeping the old facility running, noting that such powers should only be used as a last resort. This decision challenges the Trump administration's efforts to maintain aging coal plants, potentially shifting the focus back to the original plan to decommission the site.

title: At least seven killed in fire at prison in northern Syria
english: A fire at a prison in Kobane, northern Syria, has resulted in the deaths of at least seven inmates and left many others injured. The incident occurred during a riot that followed public protests over the recent killing of a former Kurdish fighter. While the official cause of the blaze remains under investigation, the event underscores ongoing instability and regional tensions in the country following the change in national leadership.

title: Danish FA allege FIFA Legal Committee evaded questions on Infantino’s plan
english: The head of the Danish Football Association, Jesper Moller, has criticized FIFA for failing to address serious questions regarding a controversial plan to sell commercial rights to major tournaments. Moller expressed frustration that the FIFA Legal Committee avoided discussing this issue, further damaging his confidence in the organization's current leadership. Consequently, the Danish FA is actively seeking a new candidate to challenge Gianni Infantino in the upcoming presidential election.
